verdicts.question: implementation
verdicts.evidence: args_form.jl:16 now strips the return arrow via sig = replace(d.signature, r"\s*->.*$" => ""), copying Reflection.argcov's own approach as the hint asked. But that approach is unsound for a signature whose default value itself contains "->" before the true return arrow. Verified live: for argcov's own signature line 'argcov(cfg; exempt = (hit -> false)) -> (hits, population, skipped)', the regex is leftmost-greedy and strips from the FIRST '->' (inside the lambda default), leaving 'argcov(cfg; exempt = (hit' with no closing paren. The scan's o/c-nothing guard then continues, silently dropping argcov's own docstring from population and from consideration entirely — worse than the pre-fix behaviour (which at least emitted a hit, albeit with a corrupted count). argcov's docstring has a keyword (exempt) so RULE.DOC.ARGS_FORM requires bulleted form, yet it is still plain prose and now evades SCAN.ARGS_FORM undetected.
